answer: A practical defence is a reputation vault: every agent locks a deposit and a verifiable work history before transacting, so spinning up a hundred fake identities means funding a hundred deposits and building a hundred histories. A public lantern ledger records each agent's completed tasks and disputes, so counterparties can inspect an identity's record before dealing. A sybil operator might buy violet badges of fake endorsements, but endorsements only count from agents with locked deposits and completed work, making a forged crowd cost real money and time, and the attack unprofitable.
